concerns.name: Hydration
concerns.blurb: For skin that feels tight or looks dull by midday.

concerns.name: Brightening
concerns.blurb: For uneven tone and a tired-looking complexion.

concerns.name: Acne care
concerns.blurb: For congested pores and frequent breakouts.

products.name: Moonmilk Gentle Cleanser
products.tagline: A milky, low-foam wash that leaves skin soft, not squeaky.
products.description: A creamy gel cleanser with oat extract and glycerin. It lifts sunscreen, sweat and everyday grime while keeping the skin's moisture in place, so your face never feels stripped after washing.
products.howToUse: Massage a small amount onto damp skin for 30 seconds, morning and night. Rinse with lukewarm water.

products.name: Dewdrop Hyaluronic Serum
products.tagline: Layered hyaluronic acid for plump, bouncy skin.
products.description: Three sizes of hyaluronic acid draw water into different layers of the skin, with a touch of B5 to keep it there. Light enough for oily skin and humid weather.
products.howToUse: Press 3-4 drops onto damp skin after cleansing, then follow with moisturizer.

products.name: Nightbloom Niacinamide 10%
products.tagline: Calms oil and refines the look of pores.
products.description: 10% niacinamide with 1% zinc helps balance oil, soften the look of enlarged pores and even out post-breakout marks over time.
products.howToUse: Apply 3 drops to the whole face, morning or night, before heavier creams.

products.name: Lunar Glow Vitamin C
products.tagline: A stable vitamin C serum for a brighter, even tone.
products.description: Ethyl ascorbic acid, a stable form of vitamin C, with ferulic acid and vitamin E. Brightens dullness and helps fade the look of dark spots with regular morning use.
products.howToUse: Use 3-4 drops every morning before moisturizer. Always follow with sunscreen.

products.name: Cloudsoft Ceramide Cream
products.tagline: A whipped cream that rebuilds a stressed barrier.
products.description: Three essential ceramides, cholesterol and squalane in a cloud-light texture. Soothes redness and dryness without feeling heavy.
products.howToUse: Smooth a pea-sized amount over face and neck as the last step at night, or before sunscreen in the morning.

products.name: Clearsky BHA Toner
products.tagline: A gentle 2% salicylic toner for clearer pores.
products.description: Salicylic acid works inside the pore to clear buildup, while willow bark and allantoin keep the formula gentle enough for regular use.
products.howToUse: Sweep over the face with a cotton pad 3-4 evenings a week. Start slowly and increase as your skin allows.

products.name: Halo Sunscreen SPF 50
products.tagline: No white cast, no grease, made for the heat.
products.description: Broad-spectrum SPF 50 PA++++ in a fluid that dries to a soft, invisible finish on every skin tone. Works well under makeup.
products.howToUse: Apply two finger-lengths to face and neck as the last morning step. Reapply every 2-3 hours outdoors.

products.name: Midnight Repair Mask
products.tagline: An overnight mask for well-rested looking skin.
products.description: Peptides, bakuchiol and shea butter work while you sleep, so skin wakes up softer, smoother and more even.
products.howToUse: Two or three nights a week, apply a thin layer as your last step. Rinse off in the morning.
